title: Baselines Before Benchmarks: code for the patient-level evaluation of compact, pretrained, and continuous-time models for respiratory sound classification at the edge
description: Code, cycle-level split, per-run test predictions, and training logs for the article Baselines Before Benchmarks: A Patient-Level Evaluation of Compact, Pretrained, and Continuous-Time Models for Respiratory Sound Classification at the Edge (Rodriguez-Guillen and Garcia-Garcia, submitted to PeerJ Computer Science, 2026). The pipeline covers signal quality control, cycle segmentation, log-mel extraction, training of six configurations on the official ICBHI 2017 split over five seeds, reference baselines that read no audio, paired equivalence tests, patient-level bootstrap intervals, INT8 quantization, and profiling on a Raspberry Pi 5. Audio from ICBHI 2017 and SPRSound is not redistributed; see README.md.
